note: Developer story checkpoints (scripts/core/scenarios.gd). Each content session adds one for what it built. Jump with --scenario=<id>, the pause menu's Chapter select (debug builds), or tools/checkpoints.sh.

scenarios.title: Wake on Shingle Point
scenarios.description: A brand-new game: the waking narration, Pell, and the humming pebble on the beach.

scenarios.title: Arrive in Saltmarrow
scenarios.description: Pebble found and kept (Lost Things done). Meet Mara, Brother Aldous and Tam at the boardwalk gate.

scenarios.title: Past the boardwalk gate
scenarios.description: Mara gave you her Harbormaster's Token and Aldous (treated gently) sent you to the beacon. Old Hesk, the greyed lofts, the Remembering Knot, and the dark headland deep in the Greying.

scenarios.title: The Burning
scenarios.description: You carry the pebble and the knot, and Hesk's word about Dunstan. Walk up the ramp to the Gull's Beacon and choose what Saltmarrow forgets (or fetch Mara's whittled gull from her first).

scenarios.title: After the burn: the lullaby
scenarios.description: The Gull's Beacon burned the humming pebble. Saltmarrow after the burn: the light, the drying nets, Mara and Pell.

scenarios.title: After the burn: Mara's brother
scenarios.description: The beacon burned Mara's memory of Dunstan (the whittled gull). Two cups by the stool; nobody can say whose the dent is.

scenarios.title: After the burn: the founding knot
scenarios.description: The beacon burned the founding knot: nets begun in the middle, Hesk silent. Mara's aftermath scene is waiting, and Aldous is ready to tell the rest of his story.

scenarios.title: The ferry's arrival
scenarios.description: Aldous confessed in full (you carry his sleeve-ember), Mara hung the green lantern and the Slow Mercy has put in. Talk to Oda Farrow at the dock end; Pell was promised a crossing.

scenarios.title: The evening tide
scenarios.description: Deed weighed, Mara gave Pell leave, passage taken (Act I's end). Ask Oda to cast off for the crossing to Thornwold.

scenarios.title: Thornwold Landing
scenarios.description: Just ashore after the crossing, with Pell along. Meet Bram Kettle at the lumber camp and look at the bramble wall across the cart road.

scenarios.title: Past the bramble wall
scenarios.description: Bram met; the ember parted the bramble wall. The straight road into the Greying, the waymark lanterns west to the colliers' clearing, Hob Marl and his clamp. Bram's salt not yet carried.

scenarios.title: The ridge and the Lamp
scenarios.description: Hob met and paid; the Keepers' ladder stood and climbed. The ridge top in the Greying: the cold Ridge Light, the keeper's lodge, and the Lamp at the lantern bench. Ask about the iron box, the ladder, Aldous, and a lantern for the stair.
